column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-7 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# independently authored expectation. The ids are the metric keys the illegal-state corpus
# battery is obliged to record, read off this phase's contract.
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   checks    the check ids tools/illegal_state_corpus_gate.py implements
# The last five surfaces name metrics whose recorded value is the literal `UNVERIFIED`:
# feasibility, render fidelity, model-runtime correspondence, and runtime behaviour are all
# discharged by later phases. They are listed so the ledger carries them explicitly rather
# than omitting them, which would read as though this register had reached them.
